{{nihongo|'''Oono Shrine'''|大野神社 (一宮市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

{{Unreferenced|date=2014th year 10月26日 (日) 11:02 (UTC)~}}
'''Ono Shrine''' (大野神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto Shrine}} located in {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|en|Ichinomiya, Aichi|qid=Q270810|lt=Ichinomiya}}, {{ill|Azai|ja|浅井町 (愛知県)|lt=Asai Town|lt_ja=浅井町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Asai Town (Aichi Prefecture)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11556970}}. Its former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} was that of a Village Shrine. It is situated to the south of {{ill|Onogokurakuji Park|ja|大野極楽寺公園|qid=Q11439660}} and beside the {{ill|Q11488847|ja|御囲堤|qid=Q11488847}}.

It is the "Ono Shrine" of the {{ill|Warrant of Deities of the Engi Era|ja|延喜式神名帳|lt=Shikinaisha}} in {{ill|Owari Province|en|Owari Province|qid=Q514506|lt=Owari Province}}, {{ill|Haguri District|hu|Haguri körzet|ja|葉栗郡|ko|하구리군 (아이치현)|pl|Powiat Haguri|sr|Област Хагури|zh|葉栗郡|qid=Q1032507|lt=Haguri District}}.

== Overview ==
* The date of foundation is unknown. It is said that the original location was slightly to the south of the current site.
* It is believed that this was originally a shrine associated with water. Before the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|qid=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, due to the enshrinement of {{ill|Hachiman|en|Hachiman|qid=Q261637|lt=Hotabebito no Mikoto}}, it was renamed as a Hachiman Shrine, but in {{ill|1870|en|1870|qid=Q7741|lt=1870}} (the 3rd year of Meiji) it was renamed Ono Shrine.
* Part of the shrine grounds now house the Ono Community Center. Within the precincts, various stone statues (including {{ill|Idols in Shinto|ja|神像|qid=Q11588751}} and {{ill|Buddha in art|de|Buddha-Statue|es|Budarupa|eu|Buda (estatua)|hi|बुद्धरूप|hu|Buddharúpa|id|Rupang Buddha|ja|仏像|km|ព្រះពុទ្ធរូប|ko|불상|nl|Buddharupa|nn|Buddhastatue|si|බුදු පිළිම|th|พระพุทธรูป|uk|Буддарупа|zh|佛像|zh_yue|佛像|qid=Q1000809|lt=Buddhist Statue}}) and stone monuments—presumed to have once been enshrined—are scattered about.

== Japanese content ==
{{Citation needed|date=October 26, 2014 (Sun) 11:02 (UTC)~}}
'''Ōno Shrine''' (Ōno-jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Azai|Q11556970|qid=Q11556970|lt=Asai-chō}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|Q270810|qid=Q270810}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}. Its former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} status was that of a village shrine. It is located south of {{ill|Onogokurakuji Park|ja|大野極楽寺公園|qid=Q11439660}}, near the {{ill|Okakoi embankment|ja|御囲堤|qid=Q11488847}}.

It is listed as the “Ōno Shrine” of {{ill|Haguri District|hu|Haguri körzet|ja|葉栗郡|ko|하구리군 (아이치현)|pl|Powiat Haguri|sr|Област Хагури|zh|葉栗郡|qid=Q1032507}}, {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki shrine register}}.<ref>https://jmapps.ne.jp/kokugakuin/det.html?data_id=181383</ref>

=== Overview ===
* The date of establishment is unknown. It is said that the shrine was originally located slightly south of its present site.
* It is said to have originally been a shrine associated with water. Before the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, after Hondawake no Mikoto was enshrined, it was renamed a Hachiman Shrine; however, in {{ill|1870|Q7741|qid=Q7741}} (Meiji 3), it was renamed Ōno Shrine.
* Part of the shrine grounds now serves as the Ōno Community Center. Within the grounds, stone statues ({{ill|Stone sculpture|Q12573007|qid=Q12573007}}—{{ill|Idols in Shinto|ja|神像|qid=Q11588751}}, {{ill|Buddha in art|de|Buddha-Statue|es|Budarupa|eu|Buda (estatua)|hi|बुद्धरूप|hu|Buddharúpa|id|Rupang Buddha|ja|仏像|km|ព្រះពុទ្ធរូប|ko|불상|nl|Buddharupa|nn|Buddhastatue|si|බුදු පිළිම|th|พระพุทธรูป|uk|Буддарупа|zh|佛像|zh_yue|佛像|qid=Q1000809}}) and stone monuments, presumed to have once been worshipped, exist in a disorderly manner.

=== Enshrined Deities ===

=== Transportation ===
* Get off at the “Ōno” bus stop on {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|ja|名鉄バス|qid=Q6810397}}, then walk 3 minutes.
** From {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|Q2856589|qid=Q2856589}} on the {{ill|Meitetsu|Q30850|qid=Q30850}}{{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|de|Meitetsu Nagoya-Hauptlinie|fr|Ligne principale Meitetsu Nagoya|it|Linea Meitetsu Nagoya principale|ja|名鉄名古屋本線|ko|메이테쓰 나고야 본선|nl|Meitetsu Nagoya-lijn|pt|Linha Meitetsu Nagoya|su|Jalur Utama Meitetsu Nagoya|zh|名古屋本線|qid=Q1137838|lt=Nagoya Main Line}} / {{ill|Meitetsu Bisai Line|Q901005|qid=Q901005|lt=Bisai Line}}, or from {{ill|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|Q871495|qid=Q871495}} on the {{ill|Tōkaidō Main Line|Q1190152|qid=Q1190152}} (Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station Bus Terminal, platform 3), take the bus bound for “Kawashima.”
